verdict.rationale: Consensus is an AI research agent, so being an MCP client is a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows Consensus publishing its own MCP server and REST API for other agents to consume. That is the server role and does not show that users can plug external MCP servers into Consensus to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
